Platforms

One page per platform. What they collect, which settings are worth changing, and exactly how to change them. Settings are verified against live interfaces, not documentation.

  • TikTok CRITICAL
    Social Media Platform

    Off-platform tracking via TikTok Pixel, GPS collection added in January 2026, no AI training opt-out for US users, and default-on ad targeting across platforms.
  • X / Twitter CRITICAL
    Social Media Platform

    Default-on Grok AI training added in 2024 without notification, data sharing with unspecified business partners, cross-device and location-based ad targeting.
  • Meta / Instagram CRITICAL
    Social Media Platform

    The Meta Pixel tracks you across millions of third-party websites. Off-Facebook Activity, Audience Network ads, AI training on posts and photos with no US opt-out.
  • Google CRITICAL
    Search, Advertising, and Cloud Platform

    Google Analytics and the Google Ads network are present on roughly 90% of top websites. Cross-product combination of Search, YouTube, Maps, Gmail, Chrome, and Android data.

All settings verified by hand against live platform interfaces. Platform UIs change — if something's wrong, let us know.
